_doc: Methodology for contract/argument.json — Act I (industry & analogy) and Act II (landscape). Not rendered on site; consumed by editors, harness/style_check.py, deploy agents. Pairs with contract/analysis_writing.json (Acts III–IV).

reference.pattern: Accepted wisdom → incentive/platform shift → intelligence/judgement → parallel markets → landscape map

register.model: Open with what London already does (damage BI, familiar forms) before any scoring primitive.
register.ratio: ≥90% industry / grid / placement mechanics; ≤10% index mention (one handoff sentence in Act II close).
register.rule: Every section names at least one market actor, facility, or regulatory move with a cite.
register.sentence: Prefer 12–22 word sentences; one longer machinery sentence per paragraph max.

sections.headline_pattern: Insurance the way London actually buys it
Copilots, autopilots, and the work budget
When always-on load met an interruptible grid
Reform on the wire, silence in the wording
Why London still prices damage, not availability

bots.ask: Why does firmness matter now in a way it did not for nine-to-five load?
bots.output: 24/7 compute, hour monetisation, queue collision with interruptible grid.

bots.ask: What changed on the network side at queue speed?
bots.output: Flexible connections, non-firm clearance, constraint pressure.

bots.ask: What access models and pilots are already in force?
bots.output: Four access types, FPP pilots, EU directive, register facts.

bots.ask: Who stacked capacity, on what form, and what trigger still misses?
bots.output: Named facilities (Nimbus, DCLP, parametric SLA), PD/BI routing, schedule gap.

bots.ask: Why do forms, incentives, and triangles prevent repricing?
bots.output: Three structural reasons; sticky PD/BI; no claims signal.

bots.ask: How does curtailment exposure differ at L1–L4?
bots.output: Role sentence per layer; preparedness not transferable.

bots.ask: Where is intelligence vs judgement in placement, and who captures the work budget?
bots.output: Copilot/autopilot distinction; outsourced register audit as wedge; opportunity-map framing.

bots.ask: How does prose hand off to the universe viz without product tour?
bots.output: One sentence on population + axes; scatter as landscape visible.

paragraph_recipe.cite_density: At least one {{cite:}} per paragraph (except opening pull).
paragraph_recipe.opening: Named actor, facility, or regulatory move — not abstract risk landscape.

anti_meta.why: harness mechanics belong in methodology section
index should be instrument not protagonist in Act I
anti_meta.regex: (?i)\b(this index is built|we built this index|our index|the index site)
